::: {#exm-parent}
#### Parents in a family

Let $F = \set{\text{Ada}, \text{Ben}, \text{Cora}, \text{Dev}, \text{Eva}}$ be five people in a family,
where Ada is the parent of Ben and of Cora,
Ben is the parent of Dev,
and Cora is the parent of Eva.
The relation "is a parent of" on $F$ (@rem-relation-on-set) is the set of four pairs

$$
P = \set{(\text{Ada}, \text{Ben}), (\text{Ada}, \text{Cora}), (\text{Ben}, \text{Dev}), (\text{Cora}, \text{Eva})}.
$$

So $\text{Ben} \mathrel{P} \text{Dev}$,
but $(\text{Dev}, \text{Ben}) \notin P$, since Dev is Ben's child, not Ben's parent.

:::
